title: Page 32 signed prime-gap to payload-junction vector

target.description: Positionwise equality between signed displacement deltas mod 29 and payload-junction deltas mod 29

summary: None of fifteen frozen positionwise residues matched; the exact upper-tail probability under p=1/29 is 1.0.
why_run: To test direct numeric-grid-to-block-junction fitting without shifts, reversals, sign inversions, alternate registers, or neighboring-rune searches.

pipeline.description: Compare fifteen signed displacement-transition residues with fifteen payload-junction GP29 residues positionwise and calculate the binomial upper tail under p=1/29.

controls: No cyclic shift, sign flip, reverse order, alternate register, or neighboring rune was allowed.
The fifteen comparisons and p=1/29 null were frozen.
interpretation: The exact signed-gap vector is not supported as a direct encoding of the fifteen payload-junction residues.
limitations: This rejects only the exact positionwise mapping.
The full rune transcription and forward next-slice instructions are excluded from the public package.

normalization_changes: Converted historical fields to the HMS run schema.
Preserved the contract, report, result, and ledger as normalized UTF-8 text.
Excluded the full rune transcription and forward next-slice instructions.

raw_artifacts.reason: All quantitative evidence used by the public claim is present; corpus text and forward instructions are excluded.
